reviewType: AI source-backed linguistic review; not human certification

framework.use: Evidence-first review and explicit scope/limitations; read as reference, no installation or scripts executed.

scope: Modern visual composition and selected vocabulary readings/meanings. No proof of educational efficacy, complete N5 coverage, human expertise or commercial licensing.

recommendations.action: Use thành phần chữ for component tiles, since 亻, 𠂇 and strokes are not all standalone Japanese words.
Label word/reading block Từ ví dụ / Cách đọc của từ; do not imply にほんご is the reading of 語 alone.
Keep a brief distinction: Tách hình để dễ nhớ; không phải giải thích nguồn gốc chữ. Specifically flag 本 and 白 in metadata.
Change 白い translation to Trắng; có màu trắng.
Keep 24 chữ sơ cấp tham khảo N5; do not claim completing this subset equals all N5 kanji or mastery.
